title: NHL球队期货ETF申请引关注，体育交易新玩法
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: How quickly do you hope these come out so you can invest? Yeah, I've been waiting for these for a while, but let's just make sure we understand what these are, right?
segments.zh: 你希望这些产品多快推出，好让你参与？是啊，我等这些产品已经有一阵子了，但咱们得先搞清楚它们到底是什么，对吧？

segments.en: So they're not sports betting and you're not buying stock in the franchise.
segments.zh: 所以它们不是体育博彩，你也不是在买球队的股份。

segments.en: You're basically like treating the team like a stock. So if you like the players, you like the schedule, you want to bet on it.
segments.zh: 你基本上是把球队当作权益资产来对待。所以如果你喜欢球员、喜欢赛程，想押注的话。

segments.en: So this is what those are going to do. It's like a tracker stock.
segments.zh: 这就是这些产品要做的，就像一只追踪权益资产。

segments.en: Yeah, it's basically like a tracker. So you know, and we want to start with the NHL right now because you had mentioned there's CME futures on it.
segments.zh: 是的，基本上就像追踪器。你知道，我们想先从NHL开始，因为你提到过有CME期货。

segments.en: I don't know if this is the right one to start with, but I think it's probably just easier for them to get licensing agreements with the NHL versus like the NFL or the NBA.
segments.zh: 我不知道这是不是正确的起点，但我觉得他们可能更容易与NHL达成许可协议，而不是NFL或NBA。

segments.en: But I think if these do get some traction, we could, there's going to be more coming.
segments.zh: 但我认为如果这些产品获得一些关注，可能会有更多产品推出。

segments.en: I think it's so interesting though that another issuer has come in as well, Round Hill, which is the issuer of DRAM.
segments.zh: 我觉得有趣的是，另一家发行商也加入了，就是发行DRAM的Round Hill。

segments.en: So it's got credibility here, also filing for 32 NHL ETFs.
segments.zh: 所以它在这方面有信誉，也申请了32只NHL ETF。

segments.en: And the New York Rangers ETF actually has a ticker proposed X and YR.
segments.zh: 纽约游骑兵队的ETF实际上提议的代码是XYR。

segments.en: Oh, yeah, that's pretty cool. Yeah, so Round Hill has a bunch of tickers on their filing.
segments.zh: 哦，是的，那很酷。是的，Round Hill 在申请文件中有一堆代码。

segments.en: So again, this is also about like a ticker race. Like there's so many ETFs coming out.
segments.zh: 所以，这又像是一场代码竞赛。因为有很多 ETF 即将推出。

segments.en: You have to try to like also grab these tickers while you can. Scarlet's way more of a hockey fan than I am, but like I have to think there's some easy money shorting some of these teams.
segments.zh: 你必须趁还能抓住这些代码。Scarlet 比我更懂冰球，但我认为做空一些球队很容易赚钱。

segments.en: Like if it was an NFL, I would just put on my money in short jets.
segments.zh: 如果是 NFL，我就会把钱押在做空喷气机上。

segments.en: Right? How hard is that, right? Yeah, I mean, you know what I want to see before I like pass judgment on these.
segments.zh: 对吧？那有多难？是的，我的意思是，在评判这些之前，我想先看看。

segments.en: So let's say like the hurricane's win the Stanley Cup.
segments.zh: 假设飓风队赢得了斯坦利杯。

segments.en: What does that mean for performance? Is that 10% is that 20% is that 100%?
segments.zh: 这对业绩意味着什么？是上涨10%还是20%还是100%？

segments.en: So if these have a lot of pop, then I think people can get into them.
segments.zh: 所以如果这些有大幅上涨，我认为人们可以参与其中。
